name: Miyu Hirano
source:
A sophomore year transferee to MSCI and a student from Class IV-C.

One of the first people truly interested in the Sacred Heart Curse Killings, true to his love for investigating the paranormal. He is also a great math tutor, consistently competing once every year and dreams of becoming a detective someday.

[spoiler]Just like Sayo, he has an interest in psychoanalysis, which he applies occasionally. Also, depending on how the story will play out, he may or may not be L.C.[/spoiler]
